dedupe_keys.name: dataset of drought based on a composite index for the sahelian climate zone of niger

description: Dataset of drought based on a composite index for the Sahelian climate zone of Niger is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley. The present dataset was created for agricultural drought characterization in the Sahelian climate zone of Niger. The dataset comprises the seasonal time series of a composite drought index (CDI) and the corresponding drought classes at a spatial resolution of 1 km2 for the period 2000-2020. Coverage: Niger. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley. The repository dates the deposit 2022; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
